description: My skills include adaptability, the ability to create good drawings, statistical thinking, and determination. These are the skills I look for. Most importantly, I value working with respect and discipline.
summary: The aim of our project was to visually design the habitats needed so that people can lead a safe, sustainable, and easy life on Mars. The goal was to carry out the necessary research to bring human life to a point where it can continue as comfortably as on Earth.
details: In our project, our task was to design and create, as a visual design, the living bases needed for a livable life on Mars. In this design, to make life on Mars easy, we included a plant production area (greenhouse), an emergency area (shelter), a dormitory, a dining hall, water tanks, and waste sorting bins (recycling bins). In addition, every base has emergency buttons. The roads and passages between the bases are built underground. For needs such as restrooms, access is also provided underground. The space exploration robot in the left corner of the project makes research conducted in space easier and helps with it.
